sloka: प्रतीच्छ च एनाम् भद्रम् ते पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना ।पतिव्रता महभागा छाय इव अनुगता सदा ॥१-७३-२७॥
transliteration: pratīccha ca enām bhadram te pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā ।pativratā mahabhāgā chāya iva anugatā sadā ॥1-73-27॥

translations.english: "This my daughter Sita will be your partner in performing her rightful duty. Accept her. Farewell. Take her hand into your own.
